title: The quantum measurement postulates follow from the other postulates

statements.text: With Lluís Masanes and Thomas Galley: the structure of quantum measurements, the Born rule and the state-update rule can be deduced from unitary quantum mechanics plus the assumption that ensembles on finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces have finitely many parameters, using the fact that how a system is split into subsystems is the observer's choice.

sources.quote: can be deduced from the other quantum postulates, often referred to as "unitary quantum mechanics"
